title: Kissed Crunchy Cornish Lamb Salad
description: A light, crunchy salad featuring roasted cauliflower, aromatic lamb stock, and a tangy pomegranate molasses finish.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat, pour in lamb stock, simmer until it reaches 65°C, then reduce heat to low and keep warm.
Toss cauliflower florets in olive oil, pepper, and salt, spread on a baking sheet and roast at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
While cauliflower roasts, zest lemon over the salad bowl to release oils.
Once cauliflower is done, remove from oven, let cool slightly, then add to the bowl.
Drizzle pomegranate molasses over the cauliflower, then sprinkle roasted almonds, feta, and mint leaves.
Pour warm lamb stock over the ingredients, ensuring the liquid coats the salad evenly.
Gently toss the salad to combine flavors, being careful not to break the almonds.
Finish by seasoning with sea salt and a pinch of black pepper, then serve immediately.
